social.author: Dawg Pound Dispatch
social.text: Dawgs at 70% to make the playoffs, up from 42%. Mekhi spent all season in Impel Down's revolving door and somehow it's paying off. Sleeping fine for once.

social.author: Habib Hive
social.text: 39%. Down from 70%. At 6-5. Kaushal has been unlucky all year and the odds just noticed too. Please let somebody else absorb the bad luck this week.

social.author: Haredas
social.text: A front moved through the standings overnight: Dawgs up 28 points to 70%, Habibsters down 31 to 39%. Habibsters face The Horse is Hea at 58% for Sonny, so the forecast stays cloudy for Habib.

social.author: Shakky
social.text: Habibsters at 39% and Sonny's the favorite? Bar's open, Kaushal. I'll set the line on how many times he blames luck this week.

social.author: Dawg Pound Dispatch
social.text: Bowers going from out to questionable is the best thing to happen to this team all week. Back around the 29th, right when the playoff race gets tight. Mekhi, keep the lineup clean.

social.author: Brucie Haters Club
social.text: Walker is questionable and wasn't even practicing Monday. 9-2 and 100% to make the playoffs and Ramon still has a groin to worry about. I'll allow myself a small smile.

social.author: Absalom
social.text: Sonny dropped Jordyn Tyson to the free agent pool. 1.5 points in his one week on that roster. Sources say the Impel Down gates swung open without a fuss.

social.author: Dawg Pound Dispatch
social.text: Mekhi swapped Bills D/ST for Bengals D/ST off waivers before kickoff. Kai is out here treating Impel Down like a drive-thru and honestly the man's earned the right.

social.author: Habib Hive
social.text: Kaushal dropped a Jaguars defense that gave him 55 points over five weeks for the 49ers. I need him to explain this to me slowly.

social.author: Shakky
social.text: Habib cut a 55-point defense for a 4-point one the week he's the underdog. I'd call that a bold strategy but I just set the line on it.

social.author: Horse Stable Talk
social.text: Sonny picked up Antonio Williams off waivers. Zero points in his one week of data, so it's either a hidden gem or a very quiet roster spot.
